name: thermal_comfort_pmv_ppd
title: Thermal comfort: Fanger PMV-PPD model
summary: Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) and Predicted Percentage of Dissatisfied (PPD) after Fanger (1970): full body heat balance (breathing, perspiration, sweat, clothing, radiation, convection) with the activity and clothing selected from two embedded lookup tables.

verification.reference: EES solution stored in the source file (57 variables) against the runnable variant thermal_comfort_pmv_ppd_coolsolve.eescode (activity row 3, clothing row 2)
verification.notes: 46/57 variables agree within 1e-3 (51/57 within 0.5%; mostly exact); the 5 EES-side overwritten cells (E_dot_m, Q_dot_m, M_dot_CO2, T_sk, H_dot_sweat) mix a second operating point into the stored panel (see README); largest consistent-subset deviation 5.2e-3 on w_R_ex (humid-air formulation).
